title: WebGPU Triangle in Rust: wgpu and WGSL
description: Render a colored WebGPU triangle with Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Explore the live demo, vertex and index buffers, shaders, and the GPU render pipeline.
imageAlt: A WebGPU triangle with a blue top, green bottom left, red bottom right, and smoothly interpolated colors on a black background.
